title: INDIC QA BENCHMARK: A Multilingual Benchmark to Evaluate Question Answering capability of LLMs for Indic Languages
reasoning: The paper focuses on benchmarking the linguistic question-answering capabilities of LLMs across multiple Indic languages. While the dataset incorporates 'cultural nuances' and texts from religious sources like the Ramayana to ensure diversity and relevance to the target languages, the evaluation metrics are standard NLP performance scores (F1, ROUGE-L) rather than a specific assessment of faith, ethics, or moral reasoning.
